SELECT l.id, l.operate_user_id, l.operate_time, l.class_name, l.method_name, l.method_params, l.return_value, l.cost_time, u.name AS operate_user_name FROM operate_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON l.operate_user_id = u.id
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{logQueryDto.operateUserName}, '%')
ORDER BY l.operate_time DESC, l.id DESC
